artifact_tensor_dtype: f32 canonical safetensors; f16 and bf16 are decoded to f32 before the CUDA ABI

C1.kernel_input_abi: uint16_t host buffer containing IEEE-754 binary16 bits
C1.kernel_weight_abi: const float* host pointers copied to CUDA half resident weights; fp32 norm parameters
conversion_points: Rust f32 embedding state -> encode_f16_bits before synapse_cuda_encoder_forward
cuda_minilm.cu copy_half converts host f32 weights to half device storage

C2.kernel_input_abi: const void* selecting uint16_t binary16 or float input by precision
C2.kernel_weight_abi: const float* host pointers copied to CUDA half resident weights for f16; fp32 norm parameters
conversion_points: Rust f32 hidden state -> encode_f16_bits when precision is f16
cuda_modernbert.cu copy_weight<half> converts projection weights; copy_float retains norms as fp32

C3.kernel_input_abi: uint16_t host buffer containing IEEE-754 binary16 bits
C3.kernel_weight_abi: const float* host pointers copied to CUDA half resident weights; fp32 RMSNorm parameters
conversion_points: Rust f32 hidden state -> encode_f16_bits before synapse_cuda_qwen3_forward
cuda_qwen3.cu copy_weight<half> converts projection weights; copy_float retains norms as fp32
